QuestInfo.name: Hatchenheit
QuestInfo.0: It seems that Spiegelmann wants to ask something of you.
QuestInfo.1: The Hatchery needs new insulation. Get some Warm Feathers from Harps to stuff in the walls.
QuestInfo.2: This should be enough Warm Feathers to make this place nice and draft-free.

0.0: I, Spiegelmann, master of the jungle, have learned a great deal about hatching things from things called 'books' in the civilized world. The first rule to egg hatching is keeping them warm! Don't you agree?

yes.0: I knew you'd see it my way. Go out to the Sky Nest and get some Warm Feathers from the Harps. I'll put those together real nice-like!

no.0: Well you're wrong! I know everything about eggs!

item.0: What do you have against warm eggs?
